name: JSON Query
description: Query and reshape JSON with jq or JSONPath
help: Write a jq program or a JSONPath expression; results update as you type. The jq engine is jaq, which supports the jq language including select, map, group_by, reduce, string interpolation and regular expressions.
Paste JSON on the left, or open or drop a file (up to 100 MB). Several JSON values in a row (JSON Lines) are each run through the query, like jq.
Raw strings prints string results without quotes, like jq -r; Compact prints each result on one line; Sort keys orders object keys.
JSONPath results show the normalized path of each match, such as $['users'][0]['name'].
Queries are stopped after 10 seconds, and at most 5,000 results are shown.
